original.statement: When realtime compositions (RTC) is disabled, Crossplane now requeues on the poll interval instead of the pipeline TTL.

decision.reason: [ev-d8c59b242874] says that when RTC is disabled, Crossplane now requeues on the poll interval instead of the pipeline TTL. The configuration stays the same but reconcile timing works differently, so behavior-changed is the right change type. The release note names no component, config key or flag for this, so a free-form protocol-behavior subject is the closest family. Its kebab-case name uses only the evidence's own words.
